title: The middleware reduces a verified Clerk session into a stable in-process principal shape
asA: downstream request handler in the project
iWant: to read a single stable principal shape from every authenticated request rather than a raw Clerk claim bag
soThat: my handler's authorisation checks and audit logging speak one project vocabulary instead of Clerk's claim-key vocabulary

acceptanceCriteria.description: For every authenticated request, `request.auth` is an object whose keys are exactly `{ principalId: string, roles: string[], organisationIds: string[], claims: object }`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated request that has passed the middleware
acceptanceCriteria.then: the observed object's own-property keys are the set `{principalId, roles, organisationIds, claims}` with no additional own properties; `principalId` is a non-empty string; `roles` and `organisationIds` are arrays of strings; `claims` is an object carrying the raw Clerk claim bag for the escape-hatch case

acceptanceCriteria.description: A source-tree scan finds no import of Clerk's SDK outside the middleware module (TAC-1001) and the session verifier module (TAC-1003).
acceptanceCriteria.given: the project's source tree after the blueprint's TACs are realised
acceptanceCriteria.when: a scan enumerates every import of `@clerk/*` or the Clerk server SDK equivalent
acceptanceCriteria.then: every match resolves to a file inside the middleware module directory or the session verifier module directory; no other project file imports Clerk directly
